Team —

Board packet window opens next week (final deliverable to investors by 2027-07-11). Finance needs certified commit numbers for Q3 bookings + ARR that we will include in the deck. I attached the working workbook (Q3_commit_table.xlsx) and a draft evidence index (board_evidence_index.pdf).

Asks (please do each item):
1) For every deal > $50k ARR in your funnel, update the spreadsheet row with a single attest value: COMMIT / PROBABLE / BEST_CASE.
2) Add the ARR value (annualized) and expected booking month.
3) Link one piece of evidence in the Evidence column (PO, signed quote, e-mail thread, procurement contact).
4) If legal or procurement approval is pending, note the blocker and the expected clearance date.

Deadline: EOD 2027-07-03 — I will consolidate on Monday and hand to Finance/IR.

Quick notes: we only include deals with sales-accepted contract terms or a signed MSA + PO in Commit. Anything that doesn't meet that should be PROBABLE and included in narrative as upside.

Attachments: [Q3_commit_table.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)] [board_evidence_index.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Thanks — short replies welcome.

—
